title: Can therapies at Pinnacle Blooms help my child exhibit less self-stimulating behaviors?
metaTitle: Reducing Self-Stimulating Behaviours in Autism - Pinnacle Blooms
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network's ABA therapy helps to identify triggers and reduce the frequency of self-stimulating behaviors in children with Autism.
html: Certainly, the trademark of Pinnacle Blooms Network is empowering every child on the Autism spectrum. Our therapists are trained in ABA therapy to determine the triggers causing these self-stimulating behaviors. Once identified, we introduce them to different coping strategies or socially acceptable forms of self-stimulation. This approach helps to gradually reduce the intensity and frequency of these behaviors.
